card.name: Early-treatment period after "especially"
card.fires_on: The word "especially" or the following "the" and "first" or "initial" in phrases like "especially during the first few months". It fires in label text about risks that are highest early in treatment.

modes.label: Especially plus time window
modes.description: The word "especially" opening a phrase about the start of use.
modes.example: may experience unscheduled (breakthrough) bleeding and spotting,<< especially>> during the first month of use.

modes.label: First or initial before a period
modes.description: The word "first" or "initial" in "during the first/initial few months or days".
modes.example: especially during the<< initial>> few months of drug therapy and at times

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning "initial" or "initially" in the next few words.
card.plain: It marks warnings that a problem is most likely in the first days or months of treatment.
